colors: Primary for main series, muted secondary for comparison
accessibility: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for lines against plot bg; direct labels preferred
when_to_use: Track metric movement over time with at least 8 points
avoid_when: There are fewer than 3 points or only one date bucket

colors: Single hue scale for one metric, split hues for grouped bars
accessibility: Sort descending and include value labels for quick scanning
when_to_use: Compare values across discrete categories
avoid_when: Category labels are long and unreadable without wrapping

colors: Up to 4 slices with distinct contrast-safe palette
accessibility: Include percentages and absolute values in legend
when_to_use: Show composition where one total is meaningful
avoid_when: There are many small slices or precise comparison is required

colors: Monochrome or two-tone stacked segments
accessibility: Segment labels and totals should both be shown
when_to_use: Compare composition across multiple groups accurately
avoid_when: Audience expects exact ranking by segment area

colors: Single neutral fill with emphasized median marker
accessibility: Bin count should be explained in tooltip/help text
when_to_use: Understand spread and skew of a numeric variable
avoid_when: Data points are too few for meaningful bins

colors: Muted points with highlighted trendline
accessibility: Point size minimum for touch and keyboard focusable summary table fallback
when_to_use: Explore relationship between two continuous variables
avoid_when: Users need exact sequence over time instead of relation

colors: High-contrast stage colors from top to bottom
accessibility: Always include stage percentages and absolute drop-off numbers
when_to_use: Visualize progression and drop-off through steps
avoid_when: Stages are non-linear or users can skip arbitrarily

colors: Two contrasting endpoint colors with thin connectors
accessibility: Directly label endpoints; avoid legend-only decoding
when_to_use: Compare rank/order change between two moments
avoid_when: More than two time points are needed

colors: Sequential palette with colorblind-safe steps
accessibility: Provide table alternative and clear no-data state
when_to_use: Show regional distribution patterns
avoid_when: Geographic area is irrelevant to decision-making

colors: Brand primary for complete and neutral for remaining
accessibility: Text labels with numeric progress are required
when_to_use: Communicate completion status across goals
avoid_when: Need to compare many categories simultaneously

colors: Positive, negative, and subtotal colors with consistent semantics
accessibility: Annotate deltas and subtotals explicitly
when_to_use: Explain contribution of gains/losses to final total
avoid_when: Audience only needs static start-end comparison

colors: Category colors with neutral dependency lines
accessibility: Ensure row height supports readable labels
when_to_use: Plan tasks across time with dependencies
avoid_when: Timeline complexity is low and simple checklist suffices

colors: Primary metric in brand color, benchmark in neutral gray
accessibility: Provide table fallback and keyboard-accessible tooltips
when_to_use: Use for cybersecurity ops reviews where fast pattern recognition drives decisions
avoid_when: Decision requires exact row-level export only

colors: Sequential scale with explicit threshold markers
accessibility: Do not encode meaning by color alone; include labels
when_to_use: Use for recruiting performance diagnostics where fast pattern recognition drives decisions
avoid_when: Dataset is too sparse to show a stable pattern

colors: High-contrast categorical palette with direct labels
accessibility: Keep axis/annotation contrast above accessibility thresholds
when_to_use: Use for property operations trend monitoring where fast pattern recognition drives decisions
avoid_when: Label density exceeds readable chart capacity
